entries.title: Proverbs 10:1
segments: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son [is] the sorrow of his mother.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:2
segments: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing; but righteousness delivers from death.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:3
segments: The LORD will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry; but He casts away the desire of the wicked.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:4
segments: He who deals [with] a lazy hand becomes poor; but the hand of the hard worker makes rich.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:5
segments: He who gathers in summer [is] a wise son; but he who sleeps in harvest [is] a son who causes shame.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:6
segments: Blessings [are] on the head of the just; but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:7
segments: The memory of the just [is] blessed; but the name of the wicked shall rot.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:8
segments: The wise in heart will receive commandments; but a babbling fool shall fall.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:9
segments: He who walks uprightly walks surely; but he who twists his ways shall be known.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:10
segments: He who winks the eye causes sorrow; but a babbling fool shall fall.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:11
segments: The mouth of a righteous one [is] a well of life; but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:12
segments: Hatred stirs up fights, but love covers all sins.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:13
segments: In the lips of him who has understanding, wisdom is found; but a rod [is] for the back of him who is without understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:14
segments: Wise ones store up knowledge; but the mouth of the foolish [is] near ruin.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:15
segments: The rich man's wealth [is] his strong city; the ruin of the poor [is] their poverty.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:16
segments: The labor of the righteous [tends] to life; the fruit of the wicked [tends] to sin.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:17
segments: He who keeps instruction [is] in the way of life; but he who refuses reproof goes astray.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:18
segments: He who hides hatred [with] lying lips, and he who speaks a slander, [is] a fool.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:19
segments: In the multitude of words, sin is not lacking; but he who holds back his lips [is] wise.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:20
segments: The tongue of the just [is as] choice silver; the heart of the wicked [is] worth little.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:21
segments: The lips of the righteous feed many; but fools die for lack of wisdom.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:22
segments: The blessing of the LORD itself makes rich, and He adds no sorrow with it.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:23
segments: To work out evil devices [is as] laughter to a fool; [so] wisdom [is] to a man of understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:24
segments: What the wicked fears shall come upon him; but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:25
segments: As the storm passes, so the wicked is no more; but the righteous [is] an everlasting foundation.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:26
segments: Like vinegar to the teeth, and like smoke to the eyes, so [is] the sluggard to those who send him.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:27
segments: The fear of the LORD prolongs days; but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:28
segments: The hope of the righteous [is] gladness; but the hope of the wicked shall perish.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:29
segments: The way of the LORD [is] strength to the upright; but ruin [is] to the workers of iniquity.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:30
segments: The righteous shall never be moved; and the wicked shall not live in the earth.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:31
segments: The mouth of the just brings forth wisdom; but the perverse tongue shall be cut out.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:32
segments: The lips of the righteous know what is pleasing; but the mouth of the wicked what [is] contrary.
